title: Production & equipment hire | Sonido Events
description: Event production and equipment hire in Melbourne. Talk to Sonido about bringing your event to life.
introCopy: Planning a party, a pop-up or something of your own? Talk to Sonido about event production and equipment hire in Melbourne.
productionCopy: Tell us what you’re putting on. We’ll work through the space, the sound and the equipment your event needs.
Get in touch to discuss the scope of your event and the production support available.

cards.heading: Sound requirements
cards.copy: Share your space and expected crowd so we can discuss a suitable sound setup.

cards.heading: DJ requirements
cards.copy: Send through your DJ rider or the setup you have in mind.

cards.heading: Your full setup
cards.copy: Let us know what else you need and we’ll confirm what’s available.

equipmentNote: Equipment availability and pricing are confirmed on enquiry.
enquireCopy: Send us your event date, venue, expected guest count and equipment requirements on Instagram.
